forwardFixRecoveryBoundary.recovery: Suspected data loss/corruption/restore need: RECOVERY QUALIFICATION / INCIDENT PATH + ESCALATE. Qualification tooling accepts isolated loopback restore only; no Production restore procedure or authority inferred.
